title: Character Prompt Builder Prompt Vocabulary
description: A categorized vocabulary resource for agent-selected image-prompt construction.

single_valued.description: One term from this category describes one figure at a time (an eye colour, a hair length, a shot size). Two of them in one prompt compete; a checker reports the pair rather than choosing.

multiple_figures_terms.description: Terms in this category that put more than one figure in the picture. A checker reads them to know that a property named twice is expected rather than a defect, and that tag-scope binding no longer holds.

close_scale_terms.description: Terms in this category that put the subject close enough for a fragile part to occupy many pixels.

opposes.description: Terms that cannot hold at the same time as this one in one picture (open against closed, standing against sitting). Written on either entry; a checker reads both directions.

fragile_at_close_scale.description: The thing this term names is one these models draw badly when it is large in frame: countable small parts (fingers, toes, teeth), thin repeated geometry (chains, spokes, mesh), lettering, and reflections. A checker reads it together with the shot scale.

part.description: The part of the subject this term speaks about (eyes, mouth, hair, tail). A checker uses it with `hides`: a term that hides a part cannot hold beside a term that describes it.

hides.description: Parts this term removes from view. Closed eyes hide the eyes, so no eye colour or eye shape can be shown in the same frame; a view from behind hides the face. Written once here rather than as a list of opposing pairs.
